run_chunked_prediction: run chunked_prediction to iteratively forecast a long trajectory by concatenating chunked predictions
run_chunked_prediction_generator: run chunked_prediction_generator to yield chunked predictions step by step for memory efficient rollout
run_chunked_prediction_multiple_runs: run chunked_prediction_generator_multiple_runs to rollout multiple ensemble samples across devices or sequentially
build_extend_targets_template: build an extended targets template with lazy dask arrays for a required number of forecast steps
review_get_next_inputs: review _get_next_inputs to compute next model inputs from previous inputs and new predictions
